Sportsbook · $500K jackpot + Beat The Boys PBT

DFS · $10K jackpot only (no PBT)

SBK jackpot = $500K split equally among 10/10 entries. Each winner’s share is rounded up to the cent, the same way the DFS file credits it (Week 2: $3,333.34 × 3), so weekly totals run a few cents over the pool. DFS jackpot = $10K split among 10/10 entries, and DFS has no prize for beating the Boys. PBT = SBK users who beat the lowest-scoring partner that week. SBK 10/10 counts for every week match the numbers posted in #cfb-pickem_ops_comms. Week 1 PBT is 245,294 in the entry file; Slack posted 254,294, likely a transposed digit.

Repeat jackpot winners

Seven SBK users have hit 10/10 twice; nobody repeated in Week 7. Three of them (46447526, 49846071, 50112121) went perfect in both Week 1 and Week 2 and have high, newer account IDs. Worth a quick eligibility check under the one-bonus-per-SSN rule.
